scope: All quote-history values and earlier-data feature perturbations; stratified uncached training portfolios; independent cash settled only at actual exits, scalar candle marks and sale decisions; independent screens including the entire shortlist; all ordinary selection maxima; every saved training exclusion and chosen robust exclusion; every daily/concentration/stress portfolio. Future outcomes do not change earlier entry decisions. This does not prove global optimality, unbiased recoverable-text sampling, executable fills or profitability.
